method.scope: prepared SQL rows materialization + group COUNT; excludes prepare, EXPLAIN, fixtures, initial rollup build, full correctness comparison, IPC/UI/parsing; alternating warm-cache variants
method.sampleReason: 3 independent timed samples with at least one warmup; slow current full-history SQL and complete-group correctness execute additional untimed SQL
method.logicalRows: matched logical aggregate input, not measured actual row/page visits
method.rss: shared sequential process; observations and lifetime peak include fixtures and verification; no per-variant memory advantage claim
method.unsupported: rollup only Asia/Seoul and includeCosts=false; other timezone/cost request transparently uses original raw SQL; capabilities and model subset/deduplicated multi-model requests outside benchmark

complexity.currentRead: indexed range O(log N + K) plus aggregation/group/sort; unfiltered O(N) provider or O(N+M) model; repeated correlated expressions increase constants
complexity.rollupRead: O(log R + S + log N + B) plus grouping/sort; full range O(R) or O(Rm); session-start scalar lookup retained for session groups
complexity.rollupStorage: additional O(R + Rm) fixed-size aggregate states and index key bytes; original facts retained
complexity.initialBuild: scan raw sources plus group B-tree/sort, conservatively O((N+M) log(N+M))
complexity.replacement: original full session replacement retained; candidate additionally deletes old affected aggregate states and scans only new affected-session facts O(C_new) plus index/group writes; index B-tree maintenance and existing validation/pricing common
complexity.worstCase: one turn per session/day/model yields R≈N and Rm≈M, no row compression; added persistent aggregate state/write cost may outweigh reads
complexity.empiricalLimit: analytical growth model, finite scale measurements do not prove asymptotic bounds; SQLite sort scratch and group-state memory not fully measured

sql.rows:
SELECT
      provider,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      NULL AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (SELECT
    t.*, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM turn_model_usage m WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> '') AS has_model
    FROM turn_summary t) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?)
    GROUP BY provider
    ORDER BY provider
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM (
      SELECT NULL AS period
      FROM (SELECT
    t.*, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM turn_model_usage m WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> '') AS has_model
    FROM turn_summary t) AS turn_summary
      WHERE provider IN (?,?)
      GROUP BY provider
    )

    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (SELECT
    t.id, t.provider, t.project_key, t.session_id, t.root_turn_id,
    t.request_title, coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
    t.started_at_ms, t.completed_at_ms, t.duration_ms, t.duration_quality, t.status, t.quality_flags,
    t.diagnostic_file_id, t.diagnostic_offset, t.last_error, t.updated_at,
    CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = '' AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
    
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
  FROM turn_summary t
  LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?)
    GROUP BY provider, model
    ORDER BY coalesce(model, '') = '', provider, model
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

      provider,
      model,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, ?) AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (SELECT
    t.id, t.provider, t.project_key, t.session_id, t.root_turn_id,
    t.request_title, coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
    t.started_at_ms, t.completed_at_ms, t.duration_ms, t.duration_quality, t.status, t.quality_flags,
    t.diagnostic_file_id, t.diagnostic_offset, t.last_error, t.updated_at,
    CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = '' AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
    
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
  FROM turn_summary t
  LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?)
    GROUP BY provider, model, period
    ORDER BY (period IS NULL OR coalesce(model, '') = ''), period IS NULL, coalesce(model, '') = '', provider, model, period
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT
      provider,
      model,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, ?) AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (SELECT
    t.id, t.provider, t.project_key, t.session_id, t.root_turn_id,
    t.request_title, coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
    t.started_at_ms, t.completed_at_ms, t.duration_ms, t.duration_quality, t.status, t.quality_flags,
    t.diagnostic_file_id, t.diagnostic_offset, t.last_error, t.updated_at,
    CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = '' AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
    
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
  FROM turn_summary t
  LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND ((started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?) OR started_at_ms IS NULL)
    GROUP BY provider, model, period
    ORDER BY (period IS NULL OR coalesce(model, '') = ''), period IS NULL, coalesce(model, '') = '', provider, model, period
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT
      provider,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, ?) AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (SELECT
    t.*, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM turn_model_usage m WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> '') AS has_model
    FROM turn_summary t) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND (started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?)
    GROUP BY provider, period
    ORDER BY period IS NULL, provider, period
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      NULL AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,

    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,

    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,

    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,

    FROM (SELECT
    t.*, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM turn_model_usage m WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> '') AS has_model
    FROM turn_summary t) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND provider = ? AND project_key = ? AND (started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?)
    GROUP BY provider
    ORDER BY provider
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

      NULL AS project_name,

      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      NULL AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (SELECT
    t.id, t.provider, t.project_key, t.session_id, t.root_turn_id,

    t.diagnostic_file_id, t.diagnostic_offset, t.last_error, t.updated_at,
    CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = '' AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
    
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens

    ORDER BY coalesce(model, '') = '', provider, model
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT
      provider,
      model,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, ?) AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (SELECT
    t.id, t.provider, t.project_key, t.session_id, t.root_turn_id,
    t.request_title, coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
    t.started_at_ms, t.completed_at_ms, t.duration_ms, t.duration_quality, t.status, t.quality_flags,
    t.diagnostic_file_id, t.diagnostic_offset, t.last_error, t.updated_at,
    CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = '' AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
    
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
  FROM turn_summary t
  LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND ((started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?) OR started_at_ms IS NULL)
    GROUP BY provider, model, period
    ORDER BY (period IS NULL OR coalesce(model, '') = ''), period IS NULL, coalesce(model, '') = '', provider, model, period
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

sql.rows:
SELECT
      provider,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, ?) AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (SELECT
    t.*, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM turn_model_usage m WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> '') AS has_model
    FROM turn_summary t) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND ((started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?) OR started_at_ms IS NULL)
    GROUP BY provider, period
    ORDER BY period IS NULL, provider, period
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

sql.rows:
SELECT
      provider,
      model,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, ?) AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (SELECT
    t.id, t.provider, t.project_key, t.session_id, t.root_turn_id,
    t.request_title, coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
    t.started_at_ms, t.completed_at_ms, t.duration_ms, t.duration_quality, t.status, t.quality_flags,
    t.diagnostic_file_id, t.diagnostic_offset, t.last_error, t.updated_at,
    CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = '' AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
    
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
  FROM turn_summary t
  LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND ((started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?) OR started_at_ms IS NULL)
    GROUP BY provider, model, period
    ORDER BY (period IS NULL OR coalesce(model, '') = ''), period IS NULL, coalesce(model, '') = '', provider, model, period
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT
      provider,
      model,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      NULL AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (SELECT
    t.id, t.provider, t.project_key, t.session_id, t.root_turn_id,
    t.request_title, coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
    t.started_at_ms, t.completed_at_ms, t.duration_ms, t.duration_quality, t.status, t.quality_flags,
    t.diagnostic_file_id, t.diagnostic_offset, t.last_error, t.updated_at,
    CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = '' AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
    
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
  FROM turn_summary t
  LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND provider = ? AND project_key = ? AND (started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?)
    GROUP BY provider, model
    ORDER BY coalesce(model, '') = '', provider, model
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT
      provider,
      project_key,
      (SELECT project_name FROM projects p WHERE p.project_key = turn_summary.project_key) AS project_name,
      session_id,
      (SELECT session_name FROM sessions s WHERE s.provider = turn_summary.provider AND s.session_id = turn_summary.session_id) AS session_name,

      NULL AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (SELECT
    t.*, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM turn_model_usage m WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> '') AS has_model
    FROM turn_summary t) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND provider = ? AND session_id = ?
    GROUP BY provider, project_key, session_id
    ORDER BY provider, project_key, session_id
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

sql.rows:
SELECT
      provider,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      NULL AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (SELECT
    t.*, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM turn_model_usage m WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> '') AS has_model
    FROM turn_summary t) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?)
    GROUP BY provider
    ORDER BY provider
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

      SELECT NULL AS period
      FROM (SELECT
    t.*, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM turn_model_usage m WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> '') AS has_model
    FROM turn_summary t) AS turn_summary
      WHERE provider IN (?,?)
      GROUP BY provider
    )

    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)

    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,

SELECT
      provider,
      model,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, ?) AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (SELECT
    t.id, t.provider, t.project_key, t.session_id, t.root_turn_id,
    t.request_title, coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
    t.started_at_ms, t.completed_at_ms, t.duration_ms, t.duration_quality, t.status, t.quality_flags,
    t.diagnostic_file_id, t.diagnostic_offset, t.last_error, t.updated_at,
    CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = '' AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
    
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
  FROM turn_summary t
  LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?)
    GROUP BY provider, model, period
    ORDER BY (period IS NULL OR coalesce(model, '') = ''), period IS NULL, coalesce(model, '') = '', provider, model, period
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

END AS model,
    
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,

  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
  FROM turn_summary t
  LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
  ) AS turn_summary
      WHERE provider IN (?,?)
      GROUP BY provider, model, period

SELECT
      provider,
      model,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, ?) AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (SELECT
    t.id, t.provider, t.project_key, t.session_id, t.root_turn_id,
    t.request_title, coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
    t.started_at_ms, t.completed_at_ms, t.duration_ms, t.duration_quality, t.status, t.quality_flags,
    t.diagnostic_file_id, t.diagnostic_offset, t.last_error, t.updated_at,
    CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = '' AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
    
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
  FROM turn_summary t
  LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND ((started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?) OR started_at_ms IS NULL)
    GROUP BY provider, model, period
    ORDER BY (period IS NULL OR coalesce(model, '') = ''), period IS NULL, coalesce(model, '') = '', provider, model, period
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

sql.rows:
SELECT
      provider,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, ?) AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (SELECT
    t.*, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM turn_model_usage m WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> '') AS has_model
    FROM turn_summary t) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND (started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?)
    GROUP BY provider, period
    ORDER BY period IS NULL, provider, period
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,

    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,

    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,

    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)

    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,

    FROM (SELECT
    t.*, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM turn_model_usage m WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> '') AS has_model
    FROM turn_summary t) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND provider = ? AND project_key = ? AND (started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?)
    GROUP BY provider
    ORDER BY provider
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

      (SELECT MIN(t.started_at_ms) FROM turn_summary t WHERE t.provider = turn_summary.provider AND t.session_id = turn_summary.session_id) AS session_started_at_ms,

    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (SELECT
    t.id, t.provider, t.project_key, t.session_id, t.root_turn_id,
    t.request_title, coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
    t.started_at_ms, t.completed_at_ms, t.duration_ms, t.duration_quality, t.status, t.quality_flags,
    t.diagnostic_file_id, t.diagnostic_offset, t.last_error, t.updated_at,
    CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = '' AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')

  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens END AS cache_write_input_tokens,

  LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?)
    GROUP BY provider, model, project_key, session_id
    ORDER BY coalesce(model, '') = '', provider, model, project_key, session_id
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

sql.rows:
SELECT
      provider,
      project_key,
      (SELECT project_name FROM projects p WHERE p.project_key = turn_summary.project_key) AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      NULL AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (SELECT
    t.*, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM turn_model_usage m WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> '') AS has_model
    FROM turn_summary t) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?)
    GROUP BY provider, project_key
    ORDER BY avg_tokens_per_turn DESC, provider, project_key
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

sql.rows:
SELECT
      provider,
      model,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, ?) AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (SELECT
    t.id, t.provider, t.project_key, t.session_id, t.root_turn_id,
    t.request_title, coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
    t.started_at_ms, t.completed_at_ms, t.duration_ms, t.duration_quality, t.status, t.quality_flags,
    t.diagnostic_file_id, t.diagnostic_offset, t.last_error, t.updated_at,
    CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = '' AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
    
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
  FROM turn_summary t
  LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND ((started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?) OR started_at_ms IS NULL)
    GROUP BY provider, model, period
    ORDER BY (period IS NULL OR coalesce(model, '') = ''), period IS NULL, coalesce(model, '') = '', provider, model, period
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT
      provider,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, ?) AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (SELECT
    t.*, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM turn_model_usage m WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> '') AS has_model
    FROM turn_summary t) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND ((started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?) OR started_at_ms IS NULL)
    GROUP BY provider, period
    ORDER BY period IS NULL, provider, period
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
