SELECT
      provider,
      model,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      NULL AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (SELECT
    t.id, t.provider, t.project_key, t.session_id, t.root_turn_id,
    t.request_title, coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
    t.started_at_ms, t.completed_at_ms, t.duration_ms, t.duration_quality, t.status, t.quality_flags,
    t.diagnostic_file_id, t.diagnostic_offset, t.last_error, t.updated_at,
    CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = '' AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
    
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
  FROM turn_summary t
  LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND provider = ? AND project_key = ? AND (started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?)
    GROUP BY provider, model
    ORDER BY coalesce(model, '') = '', provider, model
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT
      provider,
      project_key,
      (SELECT project_name FROM projects p WHERE p.project_key = turn_summary.project_key) AS project_name,
      session_id,
      (SELECT session_name FROM sessions s WHERE s.provider = turn_summary.provider AND s.session_id = turn_summary.session_id) AS session_name,
      (SELECT MIN(t.started_at_ms) FROM turn_summary t WHERE t.provider = turn_summary.provider AND t.session_id = turn_summary.session_id) AS session_started_at_ms,
      NULL AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (SELECT
    t.*, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM turn_model_usage m WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> '') AS has_model
    FROM turn_summary t) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND provider = ? AND session_id = ?
    GROUP BY provider, project_key, session_id
    ORDER BY provider, project_key, session_id
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,

    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,

    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)

    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,

      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, ?) AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (SELECT
    t.id, t.provider, t.project_key, t.session_id, t.root_turn_id,
    t.request_title, coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
    t.started_at_ms, t.completed_at_ms, t.duration_ms, t.duration_quality, t.status, t.quality_flags,
    t.diagnostic_file_id, t.diagnostic_offset, t.last_error, t.updated_at,
    CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = '' AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
    
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
  FROM turn_summary t
  LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?)
    GROUP BY provider, model, period
    ORDER BY (period IS NULL OR coalesce(model, '') = ''), period IS NULL, coalesce(model, '') = '', provider, model, period
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT
      provider,
      model,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, ?) AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (SELECT
    t.id, t.provider, t.project_key, t.session_id, t.root_turn_id,
    t.request_title, coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
    t.started_at_ms, t.completed_at_ms, t.duration_ms, t.duration_quality, t.status, t.quality_flags,
    t.diagnostic_file_id, t.diagnostic_offset, t.last_error, t.updated_at,
    CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = '' AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
    
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
  FROM turn_summary t
  LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND ((started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?) OR started_at_ms IS NULL)
    GROUP BY provider, model, period
    ORDER BY (period IS NULL OR coalesce(model, '') = ''), period IS NULL, coalesce(model, '') = '', provider, model, period
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT
      provider,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, ?) AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (SELECT
    t.*, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM turn_model_usage m WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> '') AS has_model
    FROM turn_summary t) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND (started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?)
    GROUP BY provider, period
    ORDER BY period IS NULL, provider, period
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      NULL AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,

    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,

    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,

    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,

    FROM (SELECT
    t.*, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM turn_model_usage m WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> '') AS has_model
    FROM turn_summary t) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND provider = ? AND project_key = ? AND (started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?)
    GROUP BY provider
    ORDER BY provider
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

      NULL AS project_name,

      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      NULL AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (SELECT
    t.id, t.provider, t.project_key, t.session_id, t.root_turn_id,

    t.diagnostic_file_id, t.diagnostic_offset, t.last_error, t.updated_at,
    CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = '' AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
    
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens

    ORDER BY coalesce(model, '') = '', provider, model
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

sql.rows:
SELECT
      provider,
      model,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, ?) AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (SELECT
    t.id, t.provider, t.project_key, t.session_id, t.root_turn_id,
    t.request_title, coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
    t.started_at_ms, t.completed_at_ms, t.duration_ms, t.duration_quality, t.status, t.quality_flags,
    t.diagnostic_file_id, t.diagnostic_offset, t.last_error, t.updated_at,
    CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = '' AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
    
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
  FROM turn_summary t
  LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND ((started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?) OR started_at_ms IS NULL)
    GROUP BY provider, model, period
    ORDER BY (period IS NULL OR coalesce(model, '') = ''), period IS NULL, coalesce(model, '') = '', provider, model, period
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

    t.started_at_ms, t.completed_at_ms, t.duration_ms, t.duration_quality, t.status, t.quality_flags,

    CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = '' AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
    
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
  FROM turn_summary t
  LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
  ) AS turn_summary
      WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND ((started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?) OR started_at_ms IS NULL)
      GROUP BY provider, model, period
    )

observedProcess.scope: same process shared A/B; includes prior datasets, validation and fixtures; not isolated per-variant peak

semanticChecks.coverage: both bases, all 5 groupings, excludeEmpty true/false, unknownTime default/include/exclude/only, partial-day boundaries; UTC and includeCosts explicit raw fallback

transactions.inputPreparationScope: session/model extraction and JS objects outside transaction timings; parsing/scanner not measured
transactions.unchangedScanner: not measured; no claim about scanner no-change latency
transactions.walScope: wal_autocheckpoint=0; TRUNCATE checkpoint outside each timed transaction; WAL file logical bytes/frames after commit, not physical disk I/O or fsync count

isolatedMemory.method: A fresh child per variant/workload/size. Prepared product rows LIMIT 100 + COUNT, one warmup + three repetitions. Single process observation per case; not a repeated-process confidence interval.
isolatedMemory.scope: Fixture construction, rollup backfill, EXPLAIN and full-group validation run in the parent and are excluded from child memory. Child peak includes Node startup, SQLite opening/preparation, page caches, sorting and bounded result materialization. Peak is process lifetime high-water mark, not allocated bytes or exact query scratch.

options.gc: explicit GC once after statement preparation, outside observed query phase, identical for A/B
options.concurrency: all workers sequential; warm OS cache; each child owns one variant connection

supplementaryValidation.rollbackScope: all columns/all rows of every persistent table, including projects, sessions, details, model usage, turn costs and both rollups; changed snapshots asserted before injected failure
